newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Mubarak meets Jordanian and Syrian presidents.
- Thousands of Turks demonstrate against secularists.
- King Hussein of Jordan, Saudi businessman Prince Al-Waleed hold talks on investments in Jordan.
- United Arab Emirates' gross domestic product in 1996 grew to $44.6 billion from $40.2 billion in 1995.
- Iranian sources say president-elect Khatami may choose an Arab Iranian as a defence minister.
- Saudi Interior Minister Prince Nayef optimistic about reaching a solution to border dispute with Yemen.
- Kuwait's parliament approves 1997/98 budget of 3.105 billion dinars.
- Saudi's YANPET mandates banks for a $2.322 billion loan.
- Gulf Arab states intend to ban cigarette and tobacco media advertising.
